lines.speaker: guramahsh
lines.title: Guramahsh
lines.text: Tell me, child. What pizza do you envision Guramahsh requiring?

options.text: Horse Blood, Extra Pepperoni. Thin Crust.
BLT (Bacon, Lettuce, Tangerine) Deep Pan Crust

lines.speaker: guramahsh
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: guramahsh
lines.text: Yuck, that's really fucking gross. Great!

lines.speaker: scary
lines.title: Nice Scary Guy
lines.text: GRAAAAH-! ...Oh gosh. Sorry. Didn't mean to startle you there.

lines.speaker: scary
lines.title: Nice Scary Guy
lines.text: I'd just love a pizza, if it's really no trouble at all.

lines.speaker: scary
lines.title: Nice Scary Guy
lines.text: You're doing wonderfully, by the way.

lines.speaker: poet
lines.title: Tortured Hungry Poet
lines.text: Hunger gnaws at me like an unfinished sonnet.

lines.speaker: poet
lines.title: Tortured Hungry Poet
lines.text: Endless. Aching. Unresolved.

lines.speaker: poet
lines.title: Tortured Hungry Poet
lines.text: Bring me a pie as tragic and beautiful as my unpublished works...

lines.speaker: poet
lines.title: Tortured Hungry Poet
lines.text: ...And swiftly. I am wasting away.

lines.speaker: frank
lines.title: Frank
lines.text: Yo. I'd like a pizza.

lines.speaker: frank
lines.title: Frank
lines.text: That's the whole thing. That's it. Appreciate you.

lines.speaker: dryellow
lines.title: Dr. Yellow Guy
lines.text: Ah, a fresh specimen! Er- customer. Customer. Forgive the slip.

lines.speaker: dryellow
lines.title: Dr. Yellow Guy
lines.text: My professional diagnosis is...you will prepare me a pizza.

lines.speaker: dryellow
lines.title: Dr. Yellow Guy
lines.text: It is, medically, necessary.

lines.speaker: cloud
lines.title: Mrs. Cloud
lines.text: Ohhh, hello there, dear... *drifts gently past the counter*

lines.speaker: cloud
lines.title: Mrs. Cloud
lines.text: A warm little pizza would be just lovely on a day like this.

lines.speaker: cloud
lines.title: Mrs. Cloud
lines.text: Take your time, sweetpea.

lines.speaker: guramahsh
lines.title: Guramahsh
lines.text: Guramahsh's patience is eternal. His hunger is not. The pizza, child.

lines.speaker: scary
lines.title: Nice Scary Guy
lines.text: Oh, no rush at all! I'll just wait here. ...Smiling. Sorry, it's just my face.

lines.speaker: poet
lines.title: Tortured Hungry Poet
lines.text: Still I wait... marinating in exquisite agony. As all great artists must.

lines.speaker: frank
lines.title: Frank
lines.text: Still here. Still Frank. Still waiting on that pizza.

lines.speaker: dryellow
lines.title: Dr. Yellow Guy
lines.text: The prognosis remains unchanged. I still require my pizza. Stat.

lines.speaker: cloud
lines.title: Mrs. Cloud
lines.text: No hurry at all, dear... I'll just drift here a while... *hums softly*
